dialogues.speaker: Iraj
dialogues.text: Hello, do you need any help?

dialogues.speaker: Iraj
dialogues.text: Hmm... You look strong and energetic. I don't think you do.

dialogues.speaker: Iraj
dialogues.text: Then enjoy the rainforest! The way of life in the forest may be quite primitive, but you won't find any place that is cleaner and more comfortable than here.

dialogues.speaker: Iraj
dialogues.text: I often volunteer to change shifts with my colleagues, just to wander the forest a little longer.

dialogues.speaker: Iraj
dialogues.text: ...Oh, of course I'll still carry out my duty seriously if something really does happen.
